summary: Tixel is a Melbourne-headquartered fan-to-fan ticket marketplace founded in 2017, now live in the US and UK as well as Australia. Head of Finance Shannon Joseph recently posted about automating fan refunds via Stripe Treasury and is hiring a Financial Accountant to run a multi-entity close and help rebuild finance around AI and automation.

sources.title: Shannon Joseph: Finance Business Partner post
Shannon Joseph: Tixel live in the US

claims.text: Tixel was created in 2017 and its HQ is in Melbourne.
claims.quote: Tixel was created in 2017 after our music-loving founders were burnt by a fake ticket scam.

claims.text: Shannon Joseph is currently Head of Finance at Tixel in Melbourne, since Jan 2025.
Shannon posted that paying refunds to fans from Tixel's own funds was the one money flow not yet automated on Stripe.
claims.quote: Paying refunds to our fans directly out of our own funds was the one money flow we'd not been able to automate on Stripe.

claims.text: Tixel is an early adopter of Stripe Treasury, which made refunds a single approval with less manual handling.
claims.quote: As an early adopter of Stripe Treasury, it's now a single approval with less manual handling on our side

claims.text: Tixel's Financial Accountant role owns day-to-day financial operations and month-end close across all entities.
claims.quote: Own day-to-day financial operations and a clean, efficient month-end close across all our entities.

claims.text: The same job ad describes the finance team as transforming around AI and automation.
claims.quote: a high-impact seat at the ground floor of a finance team transforming around AI and automation.

claims.text: The role supports Tixel across Australia, the UK and the US.
claims.quote: supporting Tixel across Australia, the UK, and the US.

claims.text: Shannon posted that the new hire will help shape the finance function as Tixel scales globally.
claims.quote: help shape the finance function as we continue to scale globally, beyond just reporting the numbers.

claims.text: Shannon's Finance Business Partner post (Oct 2025) says the hire will help evolve financial systems and processes as Tixel scales globally.
claims.quote: Help evolve Tixel's financial systems and processes as we scale globally

claims.text: Shannon shared that Tixel went live in the US.
claims.quote: Big news – Tixel is officially live in the US!

claims.text: The role includes putting AI and smarter tooling to work in finance processes.
claims.quote: Process, Systems & AI: Help build the way finance runs, putting AI and smarter tooling to work so the whole team moves faster.

claims.text: Tixel partners with promoters and events including Beyond the Valley and Boardmasters to verify resale tickets.
claims.quote: Tixel supports event promoters to verify resale tickets and provide a better experience for fans

claims.text: Shannon's earlier roles include Senior Manager on Block's Afterpay Finance team.

hooks.text: Shannon's Stripe Tour post on automating refunds shows she hunts down manual money flows; reconciling those flows to the ledger is the next step.
Financial Accountant ad: multi-entity close across AU/UK/US with finance being rebuilt around AI and automation.
Scaling globally with a US launch makes multi-currency and intercompany recs heavier.

risks.text: Finance already leans on Stripe Treasury automation and is building its own AI tooling, so it may build or use another vendor.

gaps: No finance stack (ERP/Xero) confirmed from a primary source.

searches.query: Shannon Joseph Tixel Head of Finance
fetch Tixel Financial Accountant job ad and about page

first.subject: Reconciling Tixel's refunds and payouts
first.body:
Hi Shannon,

Your Stripe Tour post about automating fan refunds with Stripe Treasury stuck with me. The next question is how every refund and payout then reconciles at month-end. With your Financial Accountant role covering a close across Australia, the UK and the US, and a team rebuilding around AI, that looks like the natural thing to automate. I built Vert to turn 4 hours of reconciliation into 5 minutes, with every match traceable. How is that handled across your entities today?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech
